page.overview:
What is Fire Lizards?

The Fire Lizards, also called the Fire Dragons, are a hostile species that appear towards the end of Predator: Incursion. They are fearsome enough to cause the usually fearless Yautja (Predator) to flee a fight, though of course the hunters never admit to fleeing. Category:Species Category:Sentient species
